events.text:
Assume: 9 days, **excluding flights from home**.

I can’t show private step-by-step reasoning, but here are the **key calculations**.

## Original plan: **$2,400**
**Cities:** Prague (3 nights) → Vienna (2) → Budapest (3)

| Item | Cost |
|---|---:|
| Lodging | $880 |
| Intercity rail | $180 |
| Food | $405 |
| Activities | $420 |
| Local transit | $90 |
| Buffer | $425 |
| **Total** | **$2,400** |

## Budget cut by 40%
**New budget:** $2,400 × 0.60 = **$1,440**

## Revised plan: **$1,440**
**Same 3 cities, lower-cost version**

| Item | Cost |
|---|---:|
| Hostels/private rooms | $560 |
| Buses/saver trains | $90 |
| Food | $270 |
| Activities | $180 |
| Local transit | $70 |
| Buffer | $270 |
| **Total** | **$1,440** |

## What changed
- Hotels → hostels/private rooms  
- Standard rail → saver fares/buses  
- Fewer paid attractions  
- More free/self-guided activities  

## Short rationale
- Pick nearby cities to keep transit low  
- Keep all 3 cities, cut comfort first  
- Protect a buffer so the plan stays realistic
